LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N001_Text:
My name is Suiyin. Some news from your colony reaches me, though letters arrive late and what I hear is not always accurate.

Lately I have seen more ratkin on the roads. Some seek food, some trade, and some steal. Judge each group for yourselves before letting them through your door.

I will write again when I hear more.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N002_Text:
More news has reached me. These days, {0} different kinds of visitors have passed through your colony.

I hear some only wanted a meal, while others wanted somewhere to stay. Some were hardly polite when they arrived, but stayed afterward. Knowing they have a place to live always lets me breathe easier.

I will keep asking around and write again when I hear more.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N003_Text:
The silver that reached your colony is mine. I paid all {0} of it.

I asked a carrier to take a detour. The carrier complained that so little was not worth the trip, then came back and asked me when the next run would be. I have not promised the carrier another.

The money is in your hands now. Use it for what you need. You do not have to take anyone in to repay me.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Entry_Text: After I heard this, I could only think how pitiful those children are. Don't you think so too?
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004ChildAlone_Text: I hear the child stood for a long time where the basket used to be. You had taken it apart and used the boards elsewhere.\n\nThe child asked, "Where did mother go?"
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004FamilyHere_Text: I hear the child found the mother first. Mother and child did not say much.\n\nThe child said, "You're still here. That's what matters..."
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Captive_Text: I hear the child has learned to read people's faces. At least the child is alive, though every day takes care and caution to stay that way.\n\nI drew a short line beside the child's name.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Story_Text: I hear the mother is dead, and the child could not stay. The room has been cleared. Before long, there may be little sign of what happened there.\n\nI did not write any more about it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Banished_Text: I hear you sent them past the border. The colony has fewer people to care for now, and the beds are empty.\n\nI expect a caravan may meet the one who lived again within {0} years.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Revisit_Text: I hear the caravan met them on the road. The one who lived can find food now, and the old cloth still has your colony's colors.\n\nYou can leave them by the road. You can pay {0} silver and receive {2} silver after {1} years. Or you can kill them, and the matter ends there.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004RescuePaid_Text: I hear the {0} silver has been paid. They promised to send {2} silver after {1} years. I hope I still hear word of them by then.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Killed_Text: I wrote only one sentence: "It ends here."
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Regret_Text:
I hear the mother still walks to the old place, where the child is no longer waiting.

She said, "If only that day..."

She did not finish the sentence.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Accepted_Text: I hear the food changed hands, and the trader checked the exchange once more.\n\nThe young ratkin are still in your colony. Their next meal and somewhere to sleep tonight need to be arranged first.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Cared_Text: I hear someone has been putting work aside to look after the child these past few days. Now, when the child cries, the carers know which name to call.\n\nSomeone asked, "Should we start using the old name again?"
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Dead_Text: I hear the child did not survive. May the glitterworld the child has gone to be free of famine.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Left_Text: I hear the child is no longer in your care. How the next people raise that child, I cannot say.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Missing_Text: I hear the child never settled in your colony. What happened to that child in between, I cannot say. I can only hope the child still has days ahead.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Rejected_Text: I hear the exchange fell through. The trader took the young ratkin and left in a hurry.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005TimedOut_Text: I hear the time they named has passed, and you still gave no answer. The trader took the young ratkin and left.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Broken_Text: I hear the agreed handover fell through, so the terms no longer hold.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Entry_Text: I hear a few mouthfuls of food have gone missing from your colony. There is a narrow hole at the foot of the wall, with crumbs around its edge. It looks as though ratkin gnawed through the floor to reach the food.\n\nYou can seal it with {0} wood, leave a portion of food as bait, or clear the area around it. Clearing destroys up to {1} portions of nearby food. If you leave it alone, the hole disappears after {2} days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Sealed_Text: Word reached me that the hole is filled, and today's food count finally matches.\n\nAs for who was on the other side, I hear you did not look any further.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006BaitSet_Text: I hear one portion of food was left by the hole, so tonight you are short that mouthful. After a day, go back and see whether the trail is still there.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006BaitGone_Text: I hear the bait is gone, with a fresh drag mark outside the hole. The next rain will probably make that trail hard to follow.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Traced_Text: I hear you marked a place along the trail. What is inside that place, someone still has to walk there and see.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Stopped_Text: I hear you stopped following the trail here and sealed the hole.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Cleaned_Text: I hear you searched the hiding places around the hole. The scraps you swept out are spoiled.\n\nAt least there is one less gap to watch tonight.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Gone_Text: I hear that when you looked again, the hole was gone. You cannot follow that trail any farther.
LanguageData.RHAH_Hole_NoWood: Sealing the hole requires {0} wood. Gather enough before trying again.
LanguageData.RHAH_Hole_NoFood: There is no food by the hole to leave as bait.
LanguageData.RHAH_Hole_Stale: This hole has already been dealt with.
LanguageData.RHAH_Quarantine_Stale: Whether this group stays or goes has already been decided.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Choice_Text: I hear some of the visitors have ratkin plague. Some of those visitors can still walk. Others already need someone to care for them.\n\nYou can keep the visitors here and watch them, let them go, or leave the choice for later. The plague has to be treated. Any visitor you send away still needs the strength to travel.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Quarantine_Text: I hear the patients are staying in your colony for now. They will need care while they recover.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Release_Text: I hear you told those visitors to keep traveling. Some of them moved at once. Others still have to wait until their bodies can manage it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Defer_Text: I hear these patients remain as they were for now. They still have the plague, and their departure is still undecided.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Broken_Text: I hear some patients left your area before recovering, and quarantine ended for the rest.\n\nI have had no word of where they went afterward.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Recovered_Text: I hear the people who recovered have left your colony. This time those people do not have to carry the plague on the road.\n\nI hope that the next time we meet, those people only come to ask for a meal.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Stayed_Text: I hear the people who recovered stayed in your colony. The sickbeds are empty, and those people still need a place of their own.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007AllDead_Text: I hear not one of these patients survived.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Missing_Text: I hear the visitors who had the plague are missing. I have waited this long, and I still have no word of those visitors.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Return_Text: I hear a familiar face has appeared outside your door again. That visitor had already recovered from the plague when they last left.\n\nThis time they only ask for a meal. You can welcome them or let them continue on their way.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Arrive_Text:
Someone sent me word of a visitor asking the way at your colony. At first, all the visitor said was, "We... trade for food."

{0} tried again: "We need food, and we need to know which roads are still open. Give me {1} simple meals, and I will give you the location of an old store. You can check my story first."

I hear the visitor will wait {2} days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Trade_Text: I received word that {0} gave you the promised location and checked the way back once more.\n\nThe visitor said, "Enough. Don't bring any more. I can't carry all that by myself."
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Proof_Text: I hear the visitor checked the story and said, "That part matches. I cannot promise the rest, and you do not have to believe me yet."\n\nThe visitor has matched {0} kinds of visits to the story. You can still go ahead with the trade.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008NoProof_Text: I hear the visitor said, "I may have found the wrong place," and left.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Refuse_Text: I hear the visitor left these words: "Forget it, then. I still need to get out before dark."
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Drive_Text: I hear you drove the visitor off by force.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Dead_Text: I hear the visitor who came asking the way is dead. The lead to the location died with them.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Left_Text: I hear the one who came asking the way has left your area.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Missing_Text: I asked around. The one who came asking the way is missing.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Timeout_Text: I hear the time they named has passed, and the trade was never made. The visitor left with head down.
LanguageData.RHAH_Envoy_NoMeals: Not enough simple meals. This trade needs {0}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Envoy_Stale: These negotiations with the visitor have ended.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Arrive_Text:
I hear you reached the old store, but found none of the grain you expected. The box holds hauling lists, ration counts, and a stack of damp paper.

A number on the top page was changed twice. The last change has no signature.

This site remains for {0} days, giving you time to examine it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Take_Text: I hear you packed all the records you could carry. Some pages are stuck together; take care when separating them.\n\nYou also found {0} silver. Remember to take it with you.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Leave_Text: I hear the box stays where it is, and you have noted the place. Whether the next people take the box is not mine to decide.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Hand_Text: I hear you gave the records to the visitors, who left {0} silver in return.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Share_Text: I hear you kept one copy and the visitors kept the other. This time you exchanged only records, with each side keeping its own copy.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Destroy_Text: I hear the paper and wooden box were destroyed. What the list said can no longer be checked.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Empty_Text: I hear you found the promised location, but everything worth taking was gone. It was a wasted trip.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Journal_Text: I hear another group has reached your colony. I will write down what I have heard. I still have to ask after what happens next.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_1: I hear the young ratkin reached your colony, but the people who brought them did not stay. Was it the wrong place, or did they leave the children there on purpose? I still need to ask.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_2: I hear the visitor used the wrong name. The name can be corrected. Whether that visitor stays is another matter.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_3: I hear the mothers are close to birth and still on the road. Those mothers need a place to rest, and a mouthful of food for the children about to be born.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_4: I hear this group is only passing through your colony. After a brief stop, they still have to travel on.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_5: I hear grain has gone missing from your stores. Have those who took it traveled on, or are they waiting for another chance? I have had no word yet.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_6: I hear many people came to your gate. I will note the destinations I can confirm, then ask after the others.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_7: I hear a visitor is trading information for supplies. Someone still has to walk to the place marked on the map before I know whether that visitor told the truth.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_8: I hear a caravan has come with goods. Those traders want the sales made, then they will take their own road.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_9: I hear the people closing in are hostile. You need to defend the colony first.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_10: I received news of this group of visitors. I still need to ask how much food you had left after their departure, and who stayed behind.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_11: I hear the visitors came sick. One messenger calls it revenge, but that messenger cannot name who sent them.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_12: I hear the people blocking the road want the caravan's supplies. Whether the caravan hands them over or fights, it has to bear the cost.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_13: I hear those people came on their own, with no companions to speak for them.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_14: I hear those people have come asking for help. How much you can give still depends on your own stores. I hope that food lasts until the next place where they can eat.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_1_Text: I hear people discussing a child's future again. You will need to consider this situation afresh.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_2_Text: Word reached me of another mark along that grain route. You can follow the new lead and see what is there.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_3_Text: Word reached me that the visitor can travel again. I would like to ask them to find out how the patients fared after that quarantine.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_4_Text: Word reached me that you found the place the visitor described, along with what they promised to give you.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Narrative_Progress: Event kinds before the record letter
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Narrative_Reward: Event kinds before the silver letter
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Narrative_Relic: Event kinds before the record site
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Narrative_TrustClosed: Trust is too low, so Suiyin has stopped sending asides. She still sends letters when events reach an outcome.
LanguageData.RHAH_Revisit_NoSilver: The caravan has less than {0} silver.
LanguageData.RHAH_Revisit_Stale: This meeting with the old acquaintance has ended.
